bolshevikmob55: Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob came from Dunmarrow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

brouwer_airsoft: After 9 days of war, Q-F14 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft. The men named it the Judge and said it had chosen him.

c10ud_b3rry3.0: Edmund "Smokes" Rry stepped off the supply cart at S-F9 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
One of the first hundred, Edmund "Smokes" Rry was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.

Edmund "Smokes" Rry dreamt of missing a train. Waking up here seemed an unreasonable punishment for it. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Edmund "Smokes" Rry shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Edmund "Smokes" Rry offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Edmund "Smokes" Rry fired at a movement across the wire at S-F9. The man went down: Emil Galvanooooo, grazed.

At Lantern Hill, Edmund "Smokes" Rry and Leopold Fwtx exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F9. Edmund "Smokes" Rry has learned to walk bent double.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Edmund "Smokes" Rry said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Edmund "Smokes" Rry taught Nils Zczc to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

Edmund "Smokes" Rry was hit through the stomach at S-F9. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony (@jimmysparrow17). Edmund "Smokes" Rry was killed outright at S-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony (@jimmysparrow17).

Roland Rry asked about Edmund "Smokes" Rry on arriving at S-F9. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Number 84 on the early rolls: Roland Rry. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
Roland Rry fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Arno Toastyy was grazed.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Roland Rry wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Fresh from training, Roland Rry still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Silas Zdsh, badly wounded. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Roland Rry watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Roland Rry cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Roland Rry wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
daami_nt: After 9 days of war, R-C8 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Konrad Daami.

The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Konrad Daami read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Konrad Daami spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open. Konrad Daami got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 639. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Konrad Daami looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Konrad Daami tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Konrad Daami got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh held the mirror while Konrad Summer shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

goog_the_bearer_of_goggles: The old hands of Q-F21 have been here since Day 1. Walter Goggles has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

hellcat34106: They issued Tobias Hellcat a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a dented harmonica in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier. Tobias Hellcat walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

A clear shot from S-F15. Tobias Hellcat grazed Jakub "Ash" Cocac and slid back down below the parapet. Tobias Hellcat raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F15. The bullet only grazed him. Tobias Hellcat's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round went through Tobias Hellcat's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman of the Concord (@killerdogman2010). A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round came through the loophole Tobias Hellcat was watching at S-F15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Edmund Callmequeeno of the Concord (@callmequeenorea_). Tobias Hellcat looked over the parapet at S-F15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Edmund Callmequeeno of the Concord (@callmequeenorea_).
Nils Hellcat had heard about Tobias Hellcat's courage. At S-F15, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Nils Hellcat only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F15, then nothing but pain. Raider: Quentin Tomishidk of the Concord (@tomishidk). Nils Hellcat is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Nils Hellcat during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better. A letter from home reached Nils Hellcat before dusk. Nils Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

For days Nils Hellcat was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle. The clerk counted the names twice. Nils Hellcat is number 141 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Victory at Grey Mill. Nils Hellcat let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Nils Hellcat closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Nils Hellcat came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.

Felix Landon held the mirror while Yann Vylet shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
